title: Entrance Fee Agreement Pricing, Payment and Qualification Rules
content:
Admissions and Resident Accounts rules for pricing an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, qualifying the applicant and accepting entrance fee payments.

## 1. Where the agreement is offered
Entrance Fee Agreements are offered only at the Life Plan campuses listed as eligible in the admissions standard of the plan. A request at any other Larkspur community is for a rental residency instead.

## 2. Entrance fee
The entrance fee of the agreement is the base entrance fee of the apartment type multiplied by the entrance fee multiplier of the refund plan, rounded half up to the nearest rounding increment of the plan, plus the second person entrance fee of the plan where occupancy is double.

## 3. Age
The first resident must be at least the plan's minimum resident age on the planned occupancy date, and a second resident at least the plan's second person minimum age.

## 4. Financial qualification
Financial qualification requires net worth of at least the plan's net worth multiple times the entrance fee and monthly income of at least the plan's monthly income multiple times the independent living monthly fee, shown on a financial application approved by Larkspur.

## 5. Validity of the financial application
The agreement may be signed only within the plan's financial application validity period after the financial application is approved. The validity period is counted in calendar days from the approval date, the approval date being day 0, and signing on the last day is still valid. The approval date is read from the agreement record, not from the applicant's statement.

## 6. Health screening
Where the plan requires a health screening, a health screening showing the applicant can live independently must be dated no more than the plan's health screening validity period before signing.

## 7. Deposit and balance
The deposit is the plan's deposit percentage of the entrance fee, rounded to the cent, received at signing and held in escrow until occupancy or rescission where the plan provides escrow. The balance is the entrance fee less the deposit and is received no later than the plan's balance due period, in calendar days, before the occupancy date.

## 8. Payment instruments and posting
Entrance fee payments are accepted by wire transfer, one-time ACH, personal check or certified check, never by card. Entrance fee payments may be posted only while the agreement is in reserved or occupied status, an occupied agreement taking only an upsize difference or a later second person entrance fee.

## Worked example (hypothetical applicant)
Independent Living One-Bedroom under the LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan, double occupancy: 231900.00 multiplied by 1.47 is 340893.00, rounded half up to the nearest 100 gives 340900.00; adding the second person entrance fee of 36750.00 gives an entrance fee of 377650.00. At a deposit percentage of 10, the deposit is 37765.00 and the balance 339885.00. Net worth must be at least 2.0 times 377650.00, that is 755300.00.

## Validity boundary (hypothetical dates, a 90 day validity period)
| Approval date (day 0) | Signing date | Day number | Within the period |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 May | 90 | Yes, the last day still counts |
| 1 March | 31 May | 91 | No |

## Payment posting by status
| Agreement status | Payments that may be posted |
|---|---|
| Reserved | Deposit and balance |
| Occupied | Only an upsize difference or a later second person entrance fee |
| Any other status | None |
